responsibility: This file implements the runtime result object returned after successful JIT compilation. It owns destruction of the loaded shared object handle and any tempdir handed off from playback, and provides symbol lookup for generated functions and globals via dlsym on Unix-like hosts or GetProcAddress on Windows, with platform-specific error reporting. Its role is post-compilation artifact management and symbol resolution, not code generation itself.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/jit/jit-result.h, which declares the gcc::jit::result interface and platform-dependent handle type, this same-stem .c file implements result lifetime and lookup behavior: unloading the compiled shared object, cleaning any handed-off tempdir, and resolving generated symbols via dlsym or GetProcAddress.
